row.notes: Looks key (32-bit hash at key+0) up in the package object at pkg_ref+8 (inline 12-byte key table when count field >= 0x1000000, else Vm_Find_PkgObjectKey_Thunk). If the value has its top bit set it is an object reference: resolves it (Vm_PkgObj_ResolveRootOffset) and reads sub-key 0x425ed3ca instead. Reads the value with Ne_PackedTable_ReadValueById and copies the C string into out_str (Ne_String_Reserve, buffer at +0x10, capacity at +0x8). Returns 0 on success, 3 when the key is missing.
